an6.48:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an6.48:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.48:1.3: ‘sandiṭṭhiko dhammo sandiṭṭhiko dhammo’ti bho gotama vuccati.
an6.48:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bho gotama sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti, akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti?
an6.48:2.1: tena hi brāhmaṇa taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākarosi.
an6.48:2.3: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgoti’ pajānāsi, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgoti’ pajānāsīti.
an6.48:2.5: yaṃ kho tvaṃ brāhmaṇa santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgoti’ pajānāsi, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgoti’ pajānāsi.
an6.48:2.6: evaṃ pi kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti …pe…
an6.48:3.6: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ manosandosaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ manosandosoti’ pajānāsi, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ manosandosaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ manosandosoti’ pajānāsīti.
an6.48:3.8: yaṃ kho tvaṃ brāhmaṇa santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ manosaṃdosaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ manosandosoti’ pajānāsi, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ manosandosaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ manosandosoti’ pajānāsi.
an6.48:3.9: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an6.48:4.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama …pe…
an6.48:4.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti
